title: Generalized Riesz Regression: A Unified Framework for Debiased Machine Learning with Riesz Representer Fitting under Bregman Divergence
abstract: arXiv:2601.07752v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Estimating the Riesz representer is central to debiased machine learning, yet the generator and representer model determine which regression directions their first-order conditions protect. We introduce generalized Riesz regression, which minimizes a Bregman divergence made observable by the Riesz identity. Squared and Kullback--Leibler-type choices recover Riesz regression, tailored loss minimization, and density-ratio objectives. For any twice-differentiable generator and differentiable representer model, the first-order conditions impose empirical Riesz equations in model-dependent tangent directions. Compatibility aligns those directions with regressors chosen in advance. These equations give sharp control of the systematic Neyman error and an orthogonal-score identity under exact balance. We derive convergence rates for sparse models linear in dual coordinates, reproducing kernel Hilbert space models, and neural networks,

translated_title: 广义Riesz回归：基于Bregman散度的Riesz表示器拟合下的去偏机器学习统一框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2601.07752v4 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：估计Riesz表示器是去偏机器学习的核心，但生成器和表示器模型决定了它们的一阶条件保护哪些回归方向。我们引入了广义Riesz回归，它通过最小化由Riesz恒等式可观测的Bregman散度来实现。平方和Kullback-Leibler类型的选择恢复了Riesz回归、定制损失最小化和密度比目标。对于任何二次可微的生成器和可微的表示器模型，一阶条件在模型相关的切向方向上施加了经验Riesz方程。兼容性使这些方向与预先选择的回归器对齐。这些方程在精确平衡下对系统性Neyman误差提供了精确控制，并给出了正交分数恒等式。我们推导了在双坐标中线性稀疏模型、再生核希尔伯特空间模型和神经网络的收敛速率。
tldr: 本文提出了广义Riesz回归框架，通过Bregman散度最小化统一了多种去偏机器学习方法，并提供了精确的误差控制与收敛率保证。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces generalized Riesz regression, a unified framework that minimizes Bregman divergence to encompass various debiased machine learning methods, with precise error control and convergence rate guarantees.
